records.title: Docopilot: Improving Multimodal Models for Document-Level Understanding
records.reason: Document-level multimodal inference shows a concrete latency comparison, but the work is narrowly specialized and does not establish a general LLM serving method.

records.title: Overcoming language barriers via machine translation with sparse Mixture-of-Experts fusion of large language models
records.reason: The primary abstract emphasizes translation quality and adaptation; sparse expert activation suggests possible inference efficiency, but no quantitative serving evidence is available and full text was inaccessible.

records.title: Graph-Based Approaches and Functionalities in Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Comprehensive Survey
records.reason: The survey covers graph-based RAG design and functionality, without an inference-efficiency contribution in the abstract.

records.title: FastVAR: Linear Visual Autoregressive Modeling Via Cached Token Pruning
records.reason: FastVAR is a visual autoregressive image-generation method, outside the LLM serving scope.

records.title: Generative Large Recommendation Models: Emerging Trends in LLMs for Recommendation
records.reason: This is a survey of LLM-based recommendation systems and trends, not an inference/serving efficiency study.
